text:
User: if I click on the thing it should open the transcript showing live where the tts is playing at, ideally I can tap on one of the words to jump to that point of the audio; make it stylish, don't just put the transcript on a horrible white text area like you did on the menu itself

Assistant: Yes. Clicking the HUD will now open an in-place transcript mode—not the old menu transcript. It’ll use the same dark/material visual language, follow the currently spoken word, and make each word a seek target. Hover remains the lightweight control expansion; click becomes the richer transcript expansion, still without activating the TTS app or stealing focus.

Assistant: The interaction model is now explicit: unattended compact card, hover-expanded controls, click-expanded transcript. Word seeking will be proportional to audio duration because Kokoro currently returns audio without per-word timestamps; live highlighting will therefore be approximate but useful. [...] Assistant: Agreed—the transcript is laying out each word like a tag chip, so the positive padding compounds with the row spacing. I’ll change it to read like natural prose: normal word spacing, tighter line rhythm, and the current-word highlight drawn behind the word without expanding its layout box. [...] Assistant: Yes. I’ll make the completed state linger briefly—about eight seconds—with the transcript and timeline still active. During that grace period, clicking a word or scrubbing backward should start a replay from that approximate point, rather than leaving a dead card on screen. [...] Assistant: The relisten path is now implemented: completed items linger for eight seconds, retain transcript/time/duration, and word clicks or timeline scrubs enqueue replay at the selected offset. A newly starting item cancels the linger immediately. Compilation is running. [...] User: add a hover effect so it's clear I can click on the words to jump there

Assistant: Yes—the words currently have click behavior but insufficient affordance. I’ll add a pointer cursor plus a subtle accent-backed hover state and tiny scale/luminance lift, without changing the prose spacing or causing reflow.
